title: Nationwide Sports Universe: historical canon
notice: Original fictional lore, not a claim about real professional sports. Proposed canon: draft until approved. Team names are not legally cleared.

sources.title: Ryan's Road to the LPGA: Nationwide Sports Universe Historical Bible
Game team registry (IDs, display names, hex colours)
Answers from the game owner to the import questions

open_questions.text: Confirm the four founding years and trophy names.
Approve or revise the 16 anchor events and named legends.
Decide the original 1970s franchises, relocations and expansions. The current 32 cities are not assumed to be founding cities.
Fill missing championship years and opponents in a later canon pass.
Confirm whether Burlington's pre-2019 Frost Cup was in 1995.
Confirm Darius King's and Leon Mercer's CCL teams.
Define historic season formats and playoffs only as needed by the anchor facts.
Decide how lore is revealed if the game ever starts before 2027. Today every career starts in 2027, so all 1972-2026 lore is past history.

resolved_questions.text: The bible gives no founding club count for the CCL (the other three leagues say eight). Confirm.
resolved_questions.answer: Yes: the CCL was founded by eight clubs.

resolved_questions.text: The 1996 CCL champion beat three higher seeds, so the 1996 playoffs had at least three rounds. Today's format has two. Confirm the 1996 playoff size.
resolved_questions.answer: Las Vegas beat two higher seeds in 1996 (not three), so no special 1996 playoff format is needed.

resolved_questions.text: Marco Salazar (Phoenix) and Calvin Redd (Las Vegas) are placed on those teams by reading the event text. Confirm.
resolved_questions.answer: Confirmed: Marco Salazar played for Phoenix and Calvin Redd for Las Vegas.

resolved_questions.text: Events name teams by their current city (for example 'Milwaukee pitcher', 1983). The import reads these as the current franchises playing in those cities in those years. Confirm, or say which events refer to earlier franchises.
resolved_questions.answer: Confirmed: events that name a current city mean today's franchise, already playing there.

resolved_questions.text: IGL football rookie quarterback Mason Vale shares a surname with cocktail server Celeste Vale. No relation is established. Confirm or rename.
resolved_questions.answer: Fine as is: Mason Vale and Celeste Vale share a surname, with no relation.

resolved_questions.text: Elias Voss 'won 24 games' in 1983, but the Millers won 23 of 42.
resolved_questions.answer: Voss went 13-1 with three no-hitters in 1983.
Miami, as the v0.3/v0.4 ledger says.
